sceneDescription: A hyper-realistic wooden table displays an absurdly formal tea party gone wrong: a fancy gold watch precariously balanced on a toppled teacup, tea spilling toward a pile of plain, everyday biscuits. Next to them, a miniature Indian auto-rickshaw toy (symbolizing ONDC and India) is stuck in a saucer full of spilled tea, as if stalled. Subtle, incidental branded stickers (Internet Retailing, Practical Ecommerce, Jeweller) are visible on a sugar bowl, a biscuit wrapper, and the rickshaw's underside. The objects' odd pairing (luxury watch, Indian toy, humble biscuits, toppled cup) creates a playful metaphor for failed payments disrupting subscriptions, ONDC reshaping commerce, and continued luxury sales—all as a tea party mishap.
